answers.answer: Measured from perf_bars daily closes through 2026-09-18: LITE/COHR pairwise return correlation is 0.843 over the last 21 sessions and 0.891 over 63. For reference, LITE vs SMH is 0.789 and COHR vs SMH 0.819 (63 sessions), and LITE vs GLW 0.791, COHR vs GLW 0.821. The pair correlates more with each other than either does with the benchmark or with GLW, so the business-grounds 'redundant' verdict for LITE/COHR is supported by data; the deterministic screen returning no candidates does not contradict it.
